description: PS-X, the expander for PHRASE-SEQ-16 and PHRASE-SEQ-32, placed immediately to the right of it with no gap between them. Its inputs have an effect only in SEQ mode

inputs.text: A trigger turns the first gate of the step being edited on the sequencer on or off
A trigger turns the second gate of the step being edited on or off
A trigger ties the step being edited to the pitch of the step before it, or unties it
A trigger turns portamento on or off for the step being edited
A voltage of 0-10V spread across the run modes selects the run mode of the sequence being edited. This input reads a level rather than an edge

notes: it has nothing of its own to set: the connection is made by position, and the panels must touch a PhraseSeq16 or a PhraseSeq32 with no gap between them

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
